1713763.steps:
Tab
  Type several commands partially and use the tab command to complete them.
  Type ? to view help options.
  Ctrl-A Type a command i.e. show interface x0
  Do a Ctrl-A. This should move the cursor to the beginning of the command.
  Ctrl-B, Ctrl-F, Left arrow, Right arrow Type a command i.e. show interface x0
  Do Ctrl-B four times. This should move the cursor back four letters or spaces.
  Do Ctrl-F three times. This should move the cursor forward 3 letters or spaces.
  Do seven Left arrows. This should move the cursor back 7 letters or spaces.
  Do one Right arrow. This should move the cursor to the forward one letter or space.
  Ctrl-E, Home, End Type a command i.e. show interface x0
  Type the Home key. This should move the cursor to the beginning of the command.
  Do a Ctrl-E. This should move the cursor to the end of the command.
  Press the Home key to take the cursor back to the beginning of the command.
  Press the End key. This should move the cursor to the end of the command.
  Ctrl-K, Ctrl-W
  Type a command i.e. show interface x0.
  Move with the arrow to the i.
  Do a Ctrl-K. The characters from the and including the i should be deleted.
  Type show interface x0 again.
  Do a Ctrl-W. The word x0 should be deleted.
  Ctrl-N, Ctrl-P, Up arrow, Down arrow
  Enter several commands in a row i.e. show interface x0, show log settings, cls, show status.
  Do Ctrl-P four times. The 1st command should be displayed.
  Do Ctrl-N twice. The 3rd command should be displayed.
  Do one up arrow. The 2nd command should be displayed.
  Do two down arrows. The 4th command should be displayed.

On the firewall, Add an allow access rule from wan->lan with destination ftp_public for ftp service of all users; 5. From another host on the lan( set A as its dns server), try to access the ftp server: ftp://ftp.test.com 6. Test above steps for http, ping, smtp, pop3,telnet service etc.

  1. Configure the DDNS settings correctly on the Network->DDNS page, make sure that the domain name you filled can be resolved to the wan interface ip, for example, rosa001.ddns.ms resolved to 10.103.16.240; 2. Add a custom policy as below: Original source: lan subnets Translated source:wan interface ip Original destination:wan interface ip Translated destination:ftp_private Original service:ftp Translated service:original Inbound interface:Any Outbound interface:Any Click the ok button after completed; 3. 1705080.steps:
1. Add two tunnel interface VPN policies on the Firewall A: Tunnel1 with IPSec Gateway B(X1) and bound to X1, and Tunnel2 with IPSec Gateway B(X2) and bound to X2.
  2. Add similar policies on the Firewall B.
  3. On the Firewall A, add static routes bound to each configured tunnel interface with a source set to Firewall A X0(LAN) and a destination set to Firewall B X0(LAN). Set metric to 1 in the route for Tunnel1. Set metric to 2 in the route for Tunnel2. Add similar routes on the Firewall B.
  4. Verify that both tunnel interface VPN policies are active on the DUT. Send a ping from a host on Firewall A X0(LAN) to a host on Firewall B X0(LAN). Verify that VPN traffic is routed through primary WAN (X1).
  5. Pull out a cable from X1 interface on DUT.
  6. Send a ping from a host on Firewall A X0(LAN) to a host on Firewall B X0(LAN). View static routes and access rules on the DUT.
  7. Execute the test case with IKEv1 and IKEv2 modes.
1705080.initial:
1. Firewall A(DUT)is configured with a primary WAN (X1) and 1st alternate WAN (X2).
  2. Firewall B is configured with 2 WANs: a primary (X1) and 1st alternate (X2). 3. All WANs are up.
1705080.title: Primary WAN goes down (Keep Alive is enabled in Tunnel Interface policies bound to primary and alternate WANs). VPN traffic is routed through alternate WAN.
1705080.description:
Original ID: 72
Original Title: Primary WAN goes down (Keep Alive is enabled in Tunnel Interface policies bound to primary and alternate WANs). VPN traffic is routed through alternate WAN.
Original Description: This test verifies that VPN traffic should be routed through alternate WAN if primary WAN goes down and static routes bound to tunnel interfaces for primary and alternate WANs with the same network objects are configured.
1705080.result:
VPN traffic is routed through alternate WAN (X2).
  Static route bound to primary tunnel interface policy is disabled and greyed out.
  Access rules remain enabled.

  pc ---[E0/1] Router1[E1/0]----[X0:V10] DUT[X3:V30]----[E1/0] Router2 [E0/1]---server

  pc ---[X0]DUT1[X3]-----[X3] DUT 2[X0]---server
  pc ---[X0]DUT1[X4]-----[X4] DUT 2[X0]---server
  2. add 2 vpn tunnels between DUT1 and DUT2,named test1 and test2,and enable Asymmetric Route Support
  3. add static route from PC to server through VPN tunnel test1,and from server to PC through VPN tunnel test2
  4. add relevant access rule between PC's zone and VPN on DUT1 and add relevant access rule between server's zone and VPN on DUT2
  5. send ping/http traffic from PC to server,and download large files from PC to server
  6. check connection cache and captured packets,check if the traffic pass through specified interfaces without error 7.disable Asymmetric Route Support, check if the traffic can pass through
